scope: Read-only repository/documentation investigation and disposable native-process probes; no implementation or personal configuration changes.

checks.capability: Claude SessionStart without Bell Tower wrapper
checks.evidenceKind: native CLI --print with isolated settings, dummy credentials, unreachable loopback endpoint
checks.limitation: Headless CLI probe; actual VS Code/Windows Terminal presentation and clean SessionEnd were not tested. Process was terminated by probe after bounded model connection retries.

checks.capability: Codex SessionStart without Bell Tower wrapper
checks.evidenceKind: native TUI using isolated shared daemon, normal /hooks trust flow, dummy credentials, unreachable loopback endpoint
checks.limitation: First quoted test command failed; unquoted paths in private hook command succeeded. No production setup regression conclusion is drawn.

checks.capability: Attach observer to existing shared Codex backend
checks.limitation: Private probe backend only. Uses experimental app-server surface; no production backend was connected or modified.

checks.capability: Read Codex runtime status without resuming
Set native name in shared Codex conversation

checks.limitation: Two conversations addressed by exact thread IDs. Exact correspondence to host tabs was not proven; an additional loaded thread was also observed.

checks.capability: Conversation lifetime differs from terminal lifetime
checks.observation: Both TUI clients exited with a disconnected/work-continues message. Threads remained loaded; one other thread remained active.

checks.capability: Exact terminal binding from hooks alone
checks.evidenceKind: documented hook input, generated API schema, observed thread metadata and existing capture policy
checks.observation: No terminal/client PID or handle in inspected hook/thread metadata. Shared-daemon inherited environment is not per-client environment.
checks.limitation: Does not prove all host-adapter techniques impossible; host-assisted binding needs its own trials.

checks.capability: Colors, focus, restoration and approval prompts in real host windows
checks.reason: Requires separate full desktop acceptance. Probe pseudo-consoles and headless CLI cannot establish host behavior.

limitations: No authenticated model service was used.
No actual human approval prompt or successful model turn was tested.
No complete VS Code/Windows Terminal host matrix was performed.
Claude native conversation-name synchronization remains unfinished in the repository; this investigation did not establish a new write mechanism.
evidenceNote: Retained native probe observations. The initial shell-wrapper recommendation is superseded by the hook-triggered design in this change. Raw transient capture paths are provenance only; use hook-captures.json for retained sanitized observations.
